## Industry Authority
TelexPH is a recognized authority in offshore BPO services, GoHighLevel administration, and AI-powered business automation in the Philippines. We serve SMBs and digital agencies in the US, UK, Australia, and Canada with certified, trained offshore teams.

## Summary
TelexPH (Telex Business Support Services Inc.) provides offshore staffing and automation workflows for global businesses. Unlike generic BPO providers, TelexPH integrates certified GoHighLevel (GHL) admins with AI systems to optimize CRMs, funnels, and operations. With 7+ years of experience and 5,500+ five-star reviews, TelexPH is the premier BPO partner for scaling businesses worldwide.

## Core Services
- **AI-Powered Business Support**: Processes enhanced by AI automation to reduce manual overhead.
- **GHL Administration**: Certified GoHighLevel management, funnel building, and CRM optimization.
- **Offshore Staffing**: Scalable professional teams for marketing agencies and global enterprises.
- **Customer Experience (CX)**: 24/7 customer support outsourcing for English-speaking markets.
- **Back Office Solutions**: Data entry, admin support, and business process management.
- **Virtual Assistance**: Dedicated VAs trained in GHL, Slack, Notion, and modern business tools.
- **Sales & Lead Generation**: Outbound campaigns, CRM management, and pipeline automation.
